limitations: The source Domain was draft with empty manifest task types. Candidate applicability injected route-union task types into the temporary manifest and synchronized temporary active statuses for positive cases; draft, priority and corruption variants are identified per case. No production manifest activation was tested or performed by this record.

Kernel ignores repository signals for these exact task-type matches. The macOS-only, watchOS-only and server Swift signal cases still matched the iOS Domain; fixture success records that observed limitation, not native platform rejection.

Native admission guards are instructions in ios-prepare and ios-execute. These fixtures did not execute stage Skills or verify admission-blocked behavior, receipts, host invocation or any professional stage execution.

The unknown-capability rejection fixture covers a route referencing a missing capability. It does not establish task-level dependency, toolchain, permission, device, signing or service prerequisite handling. That downstream coverage remains unverified.

No product code, build, simulator, physical device, accessibility journey, installed Runtime, distribution or release acceptance was exercised. Artifact-review passes do not confer independent product acceptance.
Embedded artifact assessments are historical digest-bound records. Revisions invalidate their applicability to changed artifacts and require fresh independent assessment.
No final full-suite result, final assembled-Pack verdict, activation completion or prospective result is asserted.
